title: ETO's Mace
description: A Custom 3D Axe-like Mace Texturepack (With a Optional Backhand-grip!)
body:
**View the Gallery for more photos of the Model!** A Custom 3D Axe-like Mace with a Optional backhand grip (Backhand is active when the mace is in the offhand, its purely for Aesthetics.)


**RELEASE** - ETO's Mace - Every Mace in the game will have a changed Texture to the new Axe-like Model

![The Backhand grip of the Mace (Offhand)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3afef61974ea36212f83e4367d2fdecb2033100.png)

This texture pack was made for 1.21.11 but it can work on other versions!
